title: Whiteout
source_detail: 동아(윤정미) 중2 Lesson 3 READING 본문 — Whiteout
body_text: Whiteout was invented by Bette Graham. In 1956, Graham was working at a bank in Texas, USA. At that time, people had to retype the whole page when they made even a small mistake. Graham was a bad typist, so she needed a solution. One day, Graham saw some window painters. When they made a mistake, they corrected it by simply painting over it. The next day, she made her own white paint and used it to correct her typing mistakes. Surprisingly, nobody noticed! Soon, everybody at the bank began using it.
